nativeDownload: Real will-download/DownloadItem.done completion and fs.readFileSync equality; setSavePath selects a deterministic destination. Installed Save dialog not exercised.
gates: Genuine engine replies are held after original handler resolves; injected read failure forwards to real invalid catalog query. Native decode hook calls original decode and only delays completion.
rendererRequestScope: Unsafe URL observer covers the controlled renderer URL after setup. It does not audit main-process setup traffic; loopback provider-utils refusal is not general network-safety proof.
transport: Exact local Chat full history crosses existing IPC before per-image validation; no full-IPC/history memory bound.
preflight: One inline source; static PNG/JPEG/WebP signatures/framing/encoded dimensions; 50000000 bytes, 40000000 encoded pixels, 32768 per dimension. CRC and compressed integrity remain native-decoder responsibilities.
postDecode: Native naturalWidth/naturalHeight positive and within dimension/pixel ceilings; viewer uses these displayed dimensions. Total decoder memory is not bounded.
deletion: Observed deletion clears owned pixels and URLs and prevents held pre-dispatch downloads; journal bytes and already dispatched downloads are not erased.
scope: All assertions executed by supplied CI; reviewer ran only offline evidence checks, no tests/apps/codecs/builds or network. No photographic, native Save dialog, remote history/inference or full-product acceptance.
